# UTC Gregorian (civil time)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/temporalFrameUTCGregorian>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The utc gregorian temporal frame — a named combination of timescale and calendar used to interpret temporal coordinates.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md).
